contracts.docstring: Construct routes without inference, database writes or maintenance jobs.
Explicit retention period and acknowledgement that the original copy becomes unavailable for execution/publication.
One observed archive revision for removal or new-data recovery; callers cannot select an arbitrary filesystem target.
List documentary copy/archive states without starting Git, cleanup or inference.
Read paged original receipts and pending failures; absence of a response is never treated as absence of an operation.
Recover the original owner decision by stable key without repeating its effect.
Resume only an explicitly selected pending operation, with its original paths, archive and scope.
Fence new use of one closed private copy and retain its original archive decision before background copying.
Apply retention before original-copy removal or recover archived bytes to a fresh destination without reviving old authority.
Restore schema67 only before any retention intent exists; later or used installations require forward repair or backup.
Read retained native material or selected older files and freeze owner-chosen data using the existing admission receipt transaction.
Require an available, unquarantined closed native author and saved complete input; do not reconstruct unknown history.
Own immutable review admission and provenance using the existing transaction, receipt and event boundary.
Reject quarantined copies before snapshotting complete evidence; accepted authors permit only explicit readonly owner reconstruction.
Resolve stored source identity and observe selected bytes without modifying files, starting processes or assigning historic task ownership.
Resolve host-recorded paths in their true project/repository scope, excluding quarantined private copies and arbitrary caller paths.
Reject new use of quarantined bytes within the caller's existing admission/read transaction; historical metadata remains readable.
Require witnessed retired grants and closed operations for this database/attempt/fence, including historical attempts; absence is not proof.
Bind persisted manifests and owner intent to deterministic complete JSON.
Identify complete snapshot metadata/content without equating it with execution authority.
Capture an owner-controlled root without redirection; configured ancestors may be readable, but allocation/archive roots stay private.
Compare the original directory object even after its explicitly requested move to private disposal storage.
Create a private new directory and persist its name; never reuse an existing entry implicitly.
Retain every ordinary, ignored and untracked byte plus link payload, and reject concurrent changes instead of inventing a stable snapshot.
Observe tracked/untracked/ignored status with a fixed credential-free Git command; a failed observation is explicitly unknown.
Verify an archived/restored data tree by content, type, mode and link payload; original inodes never transfer to a copy.
Resume only matching completed entries; partial writes stay outside the data tree and never overwrite an existing destination.
Remove only remaining entries of the already archived original revision, retaining new/changed entries and every failed deletion.
Pin original parent directory objects so a replaced symlink cannot redirect deletion outside the archived tree.
Move an original allocation atomically without replacing even an empty competing destination on the supported Linux host.
Serialize admission per installation and retain each filesystem worker until its original operation settles.
Compose only from actual runtime roots and authority, never from request-supplied paths or closure booleans.
Drain a host thread after client cancellation; durable admission cannot be abandoned mid-transaction.
Identify only this process's still-running original filesystem worker.
Start one pending original decision after commit; an uncertain receipt never selects another operation.
Admit an explicit quarantine/removal/restore and return its original identity before bounded background work.
Explicitly resume only a recorded pending effect; original completed receipts are returned without more I/O.
Observe the actual worker handle for tests/shutdown without creating or replaying an operation.
Block new decisions, drain admission and wait for every original thread before releasing the runtime owner lock.
Own native attempts and grant-bound tool closure before durable terminal states.
Compose one journal owner, native worker limits and deterministic authorized-plan dispatch; construction starts no work.
Compose explicit owner retention over actual authority and configured roots, without starting cleanup on read or startup.
Drain admissions, native/source closure and original retention threads before releasing the journal owner lock.
Journal original owner decisions and run bounded filesystem effects through an explicitly supplied trusted closure observer.
Capture configured private roots and the host closure port; HTTP cannot provide paths or witnesses.
Reject a replaced control/source root before any local effect or archive lookup.
Expose bounded owner history and immutable receipts, excluding manifest internals and closure witnesses.
Resolve only one original project-scoped operation; names and later choices cannot substitute for it.
Require the exact original retained attempt inside its project.
Return an existing original decision only when every owner-selected input is identical.
Persist the original effect intent before starting any copy, move, deletion or restoration.
Refuse active task consumers and require actual original closure under the same lock that excludes new dependent admissions.
Atomically fence new use of one closed allocation, keeping its original path and requiring an explicit retention period.
Admit removal only after retention, or a new-data restore; preserve the exact selected archive across later decisions.
Read one original receipt without running a pending effect.
Page owner history without truncating it into an implication that no other operations exist.
Show original native copies, documentary availability and retained archive metadata; listing never executes Git or cleanup.
Create or verify host-owned operation directories; UUIDs come from durable rows, never paths supplied by a caller.
Freeze filesystem scope before dependent effects, refusing a superseded or completed operation.
Seal the first complete observation, resume exact file copies and confirm retained recovery bytes before enabling removal.
Verify the original recovery archive, move the original directory into private disposal and reconcile only that revision.
Recover one selected archive to a new scoped source directory, preserving receipt identity across response loss.
Run or explicitly reconcile the original pending effect; failures retain intent and bytes and never become completed receipts.
Actual private code is archived after original domain retirement; owner scope, stable receipts and quarantine admission fences stay enforced.
Actual still-owned kernel authority defeats fabricated terminal SQL labels; the fixture restores those labels before normal teardown.
Seed a real dirty private Git copy and a closed storage-only author, with an explicit synthetic closure port.
Witness only the storage boundary; production supplies the journal-backed closure observer.
Archive tracked/untracked/ignored files, wait the chosen period, remove the original and restore bytes without reviving its identity.
A new owner edit after archive survives the old delete intent and remains visibly unresolved.
No status label or caller-supplied project can substitute for the original closure observer.
Represent a physical domain whose retirement has not been established.
A child exits after the original filesystem effect; reopening completes the same decision without deleting replacement data or duplicating recovery.
Terminate the actual writer after its file effect and before the result/event transaction.
Keep the real filesystem effect and then simulate abrupt process loss.
Disk/copy failure retains original work; corrupted recovery bytes prevent a later removal rather than reporting success.
Leave a partial temporary file just as a failed bounded disk write can do.
An unlink failure never marks the operation complete, and the original archived revision can be reconciled after the error clears.
Allow one real entry removal and then fail without a recursive cleanup fallback.
An external link preserves its payload and external bytes even when the original native allocation is removed.
An ancestor swapped for an external symlink during deletion stays unresolved and cannot delete outside the private allocation.
Replace one parent after inventory but before the actual descriptor-pinned deletion.
The host controller owns its actual thread through shutdown; cancellation of a waiting HTTP task cannot abandon a filesystem write.
Hold a real copy until shutdown has started, then complete that exact original operation.
Rollback cannot discard quarantine/history; an unused schema68 can return to67 without touching project data.
A relocated full backup retains archive bytes while an old pending delete cannot touch the still-existing original host.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
